- Commit status: set to Commit/Best Case/No Commit and add a one-line reason for changes.
- Forecast amount: verify ARR and markup for FX where applicable.

15-minute standup agenda (11:15–11:30 PT):
1) Quick lane roll (30s per owner) — confirm commits
2) Two at-risk deals to escalate and owner for next steps
3) Any required finance approvals or discount asks
